bullets.text: A sieve's seal could not see what it measures, so after a repair the reseal kept its red as 'settled' and only re-running it by name cleared it. A declared SCANS makes the subject part of the fingerprint.
closure_of is the single reader of a seal's closure (4 call sites), so re-expanding SCANS there covers recheck, settled-red and the commit's reseal in one place.
